the high SNRs cutoff rate of a Ricean-fading channel is approximately 0,39-0,26+0,26 log (S/N) nats/channel use, and that the cutoff rate of a fading channel with imperfect side information is strictly smaller than the capacity of the same channel.
the cutoff rate of a Ricean fading channel is bounded by a function of the SNR and that this bound is a tight approximation to the cutoff rate for all SNR values of interest.
